title: RefundPayment payload (compensation command, topic payment.commands)
description: Refund the captured amount in full. Idempotent: refunding twice, or refunding an order with no successful capture, is a no-op. Once any REFUND outcome is stored, a later CapturePayment is rejected. Replies: PaymentRefunded or PaymentRefundFailed.

reason.description: Why the saga is compensating, for logs and audit.
